semiconductor_relevance: High — Pentamaster specializes in Automated Test Equipment solutions for the semiconductor industry, particularly in testing and assembly for ICs and wide bandgap semiconductors.
summary: Pentamaster Instrumentation Sdn Bhd is a leading global provider of Automated Test Equipment solutions, focusing on the semiconductor ICs and power module industries. Established in 1991 in Penang, Malaysia, the company also offers factory and warehouse automation solutions, with a strong emphasis on wide bandgap semiconductors like silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN).
capabilities: Automated Test Equipment for semiconductor ICs
Testing solutions for wide bandgap semiconductors (SiC and GaN)

regional_presence.Malaysia: Pentamaster has its headquarters and production facilities in Penang and Batu Kawan.
regional_presence.United States: The company has a strategic presence with offices in the USA.
regional_presence.Japan: Pentamaster maintains an office in Japan.
regional_presence.Germany: The company has established an office in Germany.
regional_presence.China: Pentamaster has production facilities in China.
